ROTARY FELLOWSHIPS MONTH
June is Rotary Fellowships Month: Celebrating Connection, Friendship, and Shared Passions
Every June, Rotary International highlights one of its most vibrant and engaging programs—Rotary
Fellowships Month. This special observance shines a spotlight on the diverse, worldwide communities of
Rotary members who come together to connect over shared interests, hobbies, and professional pursuits.
Rotary Fellowships are more than just clubs within a club; they are a powerful way to deepen friendships,
expand cultural understanding, and foster lifelong connections across borders.
What Are Rotary Fellowships?
Rotary Fellowships are international groups of Rotarians, Rotarian spouses, and Rotaractors who share a
common passion beyond the core Rotary mission of service. Whether it’s hiking, wine tasting,
photography, music, aviation, or even chess, there’s a Fellowship for nearly every interest imaginable.
These groups offer members a chance to engage with like-minded peers globally, enriching their Rotary
experience through social activities, networking, and cultural exchange.
Why Celebrate Rotary Fellowships?
Rotary Fellowships Month encourages members to explore these unique groups, which embody Rotary’s
commitment to fellowship—one of the organization’s core values. By participating, members gain
opportunities to form friendships that transcend geographic and cultural boundaries, strengthening the
global Rotary network.
The connections built within Fellowships often translate into collaborative service projects, professional
growth, and increased cultural awareness. For many Rotarians, being part of a Fellowship becomes a
highlight of their Rotary journey, providing both joy and a sense of belonging.
How Can You Get Involved?
June is a perfect time for Rotarians to discover and join a Rotary Fellowship that matches their interests.
Rotary International offers a comprehensive list of Fellowships on its website, where members can learn
about each group’s activities and how to participate. Many Fellowships host events, webinars, and social
gatherings throughout the year, culminating in special activities during this celebratory month.
Clubs and districts can also mark the occasion by organizing events or presentations to introduce
members to the exciting world of Fellowships. Sharing personal stories about Fellowship experiences can
inspire others to get involved and enhance their Rotary membership.
Building Bridges Through Shared Passions
Rotary Fellowships demonstrate how Rotary’s spirit extends beyond service into friendship and cultural
connection. By joining a Fellowship, members open doors to new experiences, adventures, and lifelong
friendships. This June, celebrate Rotary Fellowships Month by exploring these communities of passion
and connection—and discover how Rotary brings the world closer, one friendship at a time.
